patch_description: I redesigned the ansatz around a compact mirror-symmetric encoder/decoder with trainable long-range CRZ entanglers and a shared RX bottleneck. This keeps the same fixed 8-qubit re-uploading pipeline, but reduces circuit parameters from the previous 98 to 74 while preserving a similar gate count. The goal is to improve validation/test generalization by using fewer, more structured degrees of freedom and by making the long-range entanglement strength learnable instead of fixed.
